en: The important thing in those situations is to not repeat the same mistakes again.
Yeah! My manager's gonna get an earful from me.
I'm sure things will be fine next time.
That's the manager's fault. She should have told the clients they didn't need to pay until the girls got there, and given them free drinks.
Nice idea! You're smart, Kiryu-san!
If that was the case, the club should have cut off admission so they didn't wind up with more customers than they could handle.
Totally. We were all at our wit's end that day, and I don't think the manager realized it.
Guess it was a good learning experience.
Hey, do you remember Aimi-chan? We saw her out in town the other day.
Yeah. What about her?
She's super popular is what! She blew past my rank in no time!
Don't let her outdo you. Get your own rank up and show her who's boss.
Okay! I've been doing awesome lately, so I'm not letting her get the better of me!
Don't worry about it. You can't let yourself be concerned with other people. Just do your best.
But then I'll never overtake Aimi-chan again! I have to try harder!
What's your rank right now?
I'm number ten!
Sounds like you're trying hard. But from here, only girls with real ability can get ahead. It's only going to get harder from here on out.
I guess you're right. I think I'm going to have to take on more shifts.
Good idea. Just make sure you don't drink too much while on the clock. You don't want to risk ruining your health.
I'll be fine! I'm proud to say I haven't thrown up once since I started working here!
Is that really something to be proud of?
Don't do that. If your rank still doesn't go up, then what are you going to do? You can't take on more shifts.
Uh. Umm... What should I do then?
It's not good to overdo it. You have the opportunity now to try a number of different things, so you ought to give it some serious thought.
You sure are smart, Kiryu-san. I was going to work all the available shifts this month, but maybe I should reconsider.
I don't think the owner would even okay that.
But I'm not the only girl who's annoyed at being beaten by a newbie.
Now that I think about it, the girls who were here before me probably thought the same when I passed them up. Do you think they hate me?
Maybe. Whenever someone joins an organization and shows up the people who were there first, it's natural to feel some anger about it.
Sounds like you have experience with that.
Back with the crew I used to run with, my rank was high despite being pretty young. I had to worry about guys who'd been there longer getting resentful of me.
Really? That's the same boat I'm in! Teach me your ways, master!
Guess I'd better, huh?
Don't worry about it. You need to keep aiming for the top, and don't look down.
Yeah. For now, I'm going to focus on getting myself back ahead of Aimi-chan!
They may just have to try harder than you. I'll bet they've already tried doing what you're doing now a long time ago.
But the girls here are all so amazing! They'll change their dresses, makeup, or hair at the drop of a hat if a client requests it!
They'll disappear for like two seconds, and then come back looking like someone else entirely!
That's pretty impressive. But they must really be desperate to bring in new regular clients.
You're right! I'm not letting them outdo me! So, what do you like, Kiryu-san?
You're fine the way you are now, honestly.
You shouldn't follow their example. If you do, you might lose the clients who are already into you the way you are now.
Yeah. That's why I'm not gonna change how I do things, no matter what the higher-ups tell me.
Good. I'm sure guys will find your natural style appealing.
You're right. That's why I think I'm going to have to take on more shifts.
You keep saying, "Don't worry about it."
But if I only focus on myself, aren't the people around me going to resent me for it?
Doing what you want is the best way to avoid regrets later. I've never worried about what other people think.
So, you know that thing with Aimi-chan? Well, I recently found out how she improved her numbers so much.
Oh? How's that?
It turns out that she's been sleeping with her customers.
That makes sense. There are guys who will give a hostess extra money just to butter her up, so that she'll be more likely to say yes.
Meaning what?
Meaning she's sleeping her way to the top! C'mon, you know what I mean!
Like taking naps with them?
You've got to be kidding me, Kiryu-san.
So, how did you find this out?
Well, I happened to spot her the other night... going into a hotel with one of her clients!
Aha. Caught in the act, I see.
Even worse, club policy forbids us from sleeping with our clients. It would ruin our reputation if word got around that our girls were easy.
Yeah. The real thrill with hostesses is getting as close to the line as you can without actually crossing it.
Because once that line is crossed, the customer probably won't come back.
I'd been thinking of Aimi-chan as my rival, but now I just feel like an idiot for being the only one putting in real effort.
I don't even care about being number one anymore.
You're giving up? I thought being the number one girl was your dream?
It was, but there's no way I can compete with... Well, that.
Maybe not. So shoot for number two. That's plenty prestigious enough, right?
I don't care so much about being number one so much as, like... It just bugs me that I'm losing to someone who's sleeping around.
Don't worry. The others here will see the effort you're putting in.
You'll be evaluated on your own merits in time. So just do the best you can.
That's not true. You said sleeping with clients is against club policy, right? If the club found out, they'd have to let her go.
But then I'm not beating her in a fair fight. That sort of victory is meaningless!
You want to earn the number one spot fair and square, huh? That'll be tougher to achieve.
That's fine. It's not really a dream if you can achieve the goal with no effort.
You can't blame her. She did what she felt she had to do to get ahead.
Well, now I just have to sit here feeling sorry for myself. I can't bring myself to go that far.
That's fine. If you get what you want by doing something you don't want to, you'll only end up regretting it later.
There will be plenty of other chances, so don't rush it. Stick it out and do what you can.
Why not? A lot of people make similar choices to get what they want.
You might regret it later, or maybe it wouldn't end up bothering you at all. You'll never know for sure unless you try it.
I don't really have a good reason, I guess. It just feels kinda wrong.
Maybe I'm the one who's weird.
Don't be so hard on yourself. I still like you, just the way you are.
You should do what she did. Then you'll be sure to blow past Aimi and become number one.
No way! I'd rather die!
I don't know what you think of me, Kiryu-san, but I'm not the kind of girl to do that with a customer!
So then you're giving up? I thought being the number one girl was your dream.
I did it! At long last, Hinata Osaki is now the number one girl at Elise!
You worked hard for it. I wasn't sure if you actually had the drive to make it this far.
Kiryu-san, this is all because of you. I can't thank you enough!
Thanks to whom?
Why you, of course, Kiryu-san!
I've always dreamt of being a hostess, but I never thought that dream would come true so easily.
So then I decided that being the club's number one girl would be my new dream. And then that dream came true, too!
Good for you. Dreams are a sign that you aren't yet satisfied with your life. Not having dreams shows that you're content with what you have.
How true! For now, I'm just going to bask in how good it feels to be number one.
Just don't let yourself slack off. You don't want your rank to drop back down.
Keep at it. You're only number one at this club. Next you need to shoot for being the best in all Kamurocho.
Yeah! All righty then, Kiryu-san. Make sure you keep coming by to see me!
I suppose I have to.
What's next?

en: Hmm. I mean it's not exactly a dream, but I figured I'd strive to make sure I keep my number one spot.
But maybe it'd be nice to become the manager next. Or even the owner!
You've really set your sights high.
<Color:255,200,200,255>You look super strong, Kiryu-san.<Color:Default>
Oh? Well, maybe.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Are you a tough guy towards the ladies, too?<Color:Default>
Yeah. That's what makes a guy attractive. Girls don't want a man who's meek and mild.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hmm. Really?<Color:Default>
Not really. Looking tough is all the more reason to make sure I act like a gentleman, and to treat women with kindness.
Oh, that's an awesome attitude to have! You're so mature, Kiryu-san!
<Color:255,200,200,255>I can't stand guys who'd mistreat a woman on a date. I drop them as fast as I can!<Color:Default>
You're right to leave them. You don't have to date a guy who's violent towards women.
<Color:255,200,200,255>There's a lot more to it than that!<Color:Default>
Oh? Such as?
Try to tough it out. Nobody's perfect. You need to be able to overlook a few flaws here and there, or you'll never be able to date anyone.
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's what they all say. But what isn't a big deal to one person might be more than another person can tolerate, you know?<Color:Default>
What sort of things do you mean by that?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Okay, so like...<Color:Default>
Mistreat how?
<Color:255,200,200,255>You know, like abuse.<Color:Default>
Abuse? You mean like domestic violence?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah! Between a man and a woman.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>There's also stuff like demanding you answer phone calls right away, or nagging about why you didn't answer their emails.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>They don't let you hang out with other guys, always ask where you are, and demand to see your phone to make sure you're faithful.<Color:Default>
That's awful. Where do they get off doing that?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Right!? And then if you don't do what they say, they'll get really angry! It's the worst.<Color:Default>
I'd never do that. If anything, I'd be the one getting yelled at. I'm not good with stuff like emails.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Haha! That's a much better problem! It sucks getting bombarded with emails around the clock!<Color:Default>
I suppose it must.
Us guys worry too. It's a sign that we care about a girl. It'd be natural to doubt our affections if we did nothing to show them.
<Color:255,200,200,255>If you cared about us, then you wouldn't do such nasty things! Ugh, why are guys always so pushy?<Color:Default>
You have a point. It's not good when a guy thinks he's all high and mighty. Respecting your partner lets you build a good foundation.
<Color:255,200,200,255>See, that's what I think! No way am I going to date someone who looks down on me.<Color:Default>
Yes, a man should be humble.
That's what being a couple is. You can't really say you're dating until you're interacting with each other like that, right?
<Color:255,200,200,255>No! I'm not going to put up with a guy who tries to touch me or always forces things his way. That isn't what being in a relationship is about.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Gosh, you really don't get women.<Color:Default>
I guess I should be more careful myself.
Women are the same way. There are plenty of women who will talk to their boyfriends like that.
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's the other side of the coin. Guys can be victims too.<Color:Default>
Right. That happens in other kinds of domestic violence cases.
<Color:255,200,200,255>If you experience it yourself, you wouldn't like it either, right? Is it too much to ask for your partner to understand that?<Color:Default>
It's not okay for either men or women to take things too far, I guess.
Do you fear what they'll see? If you're not cheating, you should be fine with a guy looking at your phone.
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's not the point! Why should my boyfriend need to see emails I exchange with my friends?<Color:Default>
How's he going to know you're emailing a friend if he doesn't see it for himself?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I feel like if a guy can't believe what I say, I'm better off not dating him.<Color:Default>
